pos.personaBrief: PSG's positional play secures possession with five players around the opposing block, and Luis Enrique says 'we prefer to get the ball, keep the ball' (2026), adapting only when the opponent is better.

pro.personaBrief: He builds from the goalkeeper with numerical superiority even against high presses (Sports Mole 2025), seeks verticality from centre-backs and full-backs, and counters incisively (Inter final), a vertical edge on positional play.

est.personaBrief: Jeu de position 2.0 with 3-2-2-3 and five inside, five outside gives a clear structure, but players rotate and have no fixed individual reference points (CulturePSG 2026), and the false-9 drops and wingers cut inside.

lar.personaBrief: PSG attacks the wide areas first from the 4-3-3 (Coaches' Voice final), with wingers who stay wide yet cut inside, and five outside players around the block against a deep defence.

blo.personaBrief: PSG presses player-to-player against build-up and the front line leads the press (Coaches' Voice 2025, 'cuando uno presiona el resto le sigue'), defending high with man-oriented duels.

mar.personaBrief: Open-play pressing is player-to-player and centre-backs follow forwards to duel, while set pieces use a mixed zone and the team has no fixed individual markers (CulturePSG), so a mixed marking profile leaning man.

pla.personaBrief: He imposes a strong game model that the players must fit, and stresses sticking to the idea (stated 2022), while admitting to adapt when the opponent is better (2026) and varying the system, so identity dominates.

res.personaBrief: He promises attacking play and says the result worries him least, favouring how the team plays; with a 5-0 final and a league of fluid attack he plays to win away and does not shut games down.

sis.personaBrief: Stars serve the team and not the reverse (2025); Dembele's effort and tracking were demanded and Kvaratskhelia added energy in a system rewarding effort over ego, with defined roles for all.

jog.personaBrief: Technically gifted, ball-playing players with high-intensity work rate (Vitinha, Kvaratskhelia, a pressing front line); technique is valued, but intensity is a requirement and no non-runners are tolerated.

bas.personaBrief: PSG fielded the youngest squad in the last 16 (Reuters), built via signings such as Kvaratskhelia, Neves and Pacho, with titles as the aim and rotation of young players like Barcola.

lid.personaBrief: He left Dembele out for being late before the Arsenal tie and called it his best decision, applying rules to stars; he manages through a firm authority and demands that stars serve the team.
